heading: Expenditures
lead: In accordance with policies and procedures approved by the Speaker, the Parliamentarian may make such expenditures as may be necessary or appropriate for the functioning of the Office.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section is based on section 5 of House Resolution No. 502, Ninety-fifth Congress, Apr. 20, 1977, which was enacted into permanent law by Pub. L. 95–94.

ancestors.heading: OFFICE OF PARLIAMENTARIAN OF HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
